verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail's own docs say mail can be opened and scanned on request, with a stated turnaround of usually within 6 business hours, which meets the same/next-business-day bar. PDF output is documented only for registered-agent legal documents, and searchable (OCR) text is never mentioned; tagging is the only findability feature. Missing for 10: PDF output documented for general mailbox scans, OCR/searchable text, independent or hands-on corroboration of the turnaround.

support.subject: As an operator, my mail is opened and scanned to searchable PDFs with a stated turnaround — same or next business day — not just an envelope photo

citations.quote: Request to have your mail opened and scanned for convenient online access. Mail scanning requests are usually processed within 6 business hours.
All forwarded documents are scanned and stored as PDF files on the cloud.
Mail scanning, forwarding, and unlimited cloud storage
